title: Ember Drift
description: A dark, atmospheric shader effect featuring vertical streams of glowing particles arranged in parallel columns against a nearly black background. The dominant visual elements are four vertical light trails composed of small golden-orange dots that create luminous strands flowing upward with a gentle wave-like undulation. The particles exhibit a warm amber glow with a halo effect, creating depth through luminance-based shading. The leftmost and rightmost columns show more pronounced curvature and wave motion, while the center columns remain more linear. The effect demonstrates motion blur and trailing, with particles appearing to flow continuously upward at a moderate speed. The overall atmosphere is moody and ethereal, with the warm orange tones creating contrast against the dark brown-black background. The particle field has approximately 21,500 particles creating a dense, granular texture. The glow effect on individual particles creates soft halos that blend together, and the exposure adjustment brightens the highlights while maintaining deep shadows. The composition suggests vertical energy or data flow, with a cinematic quality enhanced by the depth-of-field effect and particle size variation.
